description: Source code defining Redis-based embeddings cache classes and related utilities for a machine learning or NLP project, including Redis connection setup, embedding caching, and storage management.

classes.name: RedisEmbeddingsCache
classes.description: Implements a cache for embeddings using Redis, with initialization and credential handling.

classes.name: CacheBackedEmbeddings
classes.description: Embeddings class that caches embedding vectors in Redis and manages embedding storage.

classes.name: EncoderBackedStore
classes.description: A storage wrapper that serializes/deserializes data for storage in a base store, used for document and embedding storage.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Redis client and creates a cache store for embeddings.

methods.name: embedQuery
methods.description: Embeds a query string, then quits Redis client.

methods.name: embedDocuments
methods.description: Embeds multiple documents, retrieves from cache or computes missing vectors, then stores them.

methods.name: fromBytesStore
methods.description: Creates a CacheBackedEmbeddings instance from a byte store with optional namespace and Redis client.

methods.name: mget
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values from the underlying store, deserializing them.

methods.name: mset
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in the underlying store, serializing them.

methods.name: mdelete
methods.description: Deletes multiple keys from the underlying store.

methods.name: yieldKeys
methods.description: Asynchronously yields keys from the underlying store with optional prefix.
